title: CVE-2026-76461: Cisco Email Gateway Flaw Exploited
content_md: CVE-2026-76461: Cisco Email Gateway Flaw Exploited Cisco has confirmed active exploitation of CVE-2026-76461 , a critical SQL injection vulnerability in Cisco Secure Email Gateway that can lead to operating-system command execution with root privileges. Cisco disclosed the vulnerability on September 14, 2026, after its Product Security Incident Response Team (PSIRT) became aware of exploitation. CISA added CVE-2026-76461 to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog the same day. What Is CVE-2026-76461? CVE-2026-76461 (CVSS 9.8) is an SQL injection vulnerability , classified as CWE-89, in the email-parsing logic of Cisco AsyncOS Software for Cisco Secure Email Gateway. The vulnerability results from insufficient validation during email parsing. According to Cisco, an unauthenticated remote attacker can exploit it by sending a crafted email containing malicious SQL statements through an affected gateway. Successful exploitation can lead to arbitrary SQL execution and ultimately command execution with root privileges on the underlying operating system.
